title: Operations Director
text:
**Position:** Operations Director

**Overview:**

The Operations Director oversees day-to-day operations across multiple departments, manages resources and people, and helps implement workflows to ensure Ambient Inks is running smoothly and in line with our strategic goals. This position requires an organized, systems-level thinker and someone confident in both their own leadership and management abilities. An emotional intelligence based approach to supervision, and an eye for developing and implementing complex processes, will serve this position well.

We like to bring on humans that have an interest in music, art, sustainability and are actively working towards improving the well-being of people and the planet. It’s important to us that whomever we hire backs our and thrives in a tight-knit, fast paced environment.

**Our Company:**

What started as a 2-human screen printing shop in a garage in 2009, has quickly evolved into an all encompassing artist merch design/production/management/fulfillment company based in Eau Claire, WI. We work with any array of artists from those that play house shows to artists touring the globe, along with various other clients that share our values. We’re committed to doing business in a way that puts people and planet first, a mindset that rethinks the impact merch can have on our world.

For more info about what we’re all about, check out our website.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Employment at will:**

This position follows the employment at will standards.

**Ideal Start Date:**

December 2026

**Position Type: Full Time Salaried (40hr/week)**

This is a salaried position. The anticipated hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm. Additional hours may be required at times.

**Compensation:**

The expected salary range for this position is $60k–$65k annually.

**Benefits:**

All full time positions (average 32–40 hours per week) receive:

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Savings with up to a 4% employer match
* Profit Share Plan (This is structured as a year-end bonus plan that awards 20% of profits to staff, split equitably according to relative compensation of all members.)
* Paid Holidays (9 paid holidays per calendar year)
* Paid Time Off
* 1st Year – 1 hour earned per 32.5 hours worked (~8 day annual equivalent)
* 2nd Year – 1 hour earned per 23.5 hours worked (~11 day annual equivalent)
* 3rd Year+ – 1 hour earned per 18.5 hours worked (~14 day annual equivalent)
* Sick/Mental Health Time Off (5 days per calendar year)
* Paid Volunteer Time Off (3 days per calendar year)
* Maternity/Paternity/Adoption Leave (Eligible after 1 year of employment)
* Sabbatical Leave (Eligible after 10 years of employment)
* 20% off custom merch orders

**Primary Roles:**

*Please note, these roles are inclusive of working closely with many members of the team. Additional roles and responsibilities, as assigned.*

**Leadership / Company Culture:**

* Embodies our, and empowers staff to do the same. Provides insights and feedback on how we can continue evolving our philosophy and leadership/operations responsibilities as we grow

* Works out of our Eau Claire location regularly to allow for greater engagement with staff, and better understand the day-to-day operations of Production, Logistics, and Fulfillment

* Cultivates an environment in which staff feel supported, heard, appreciated, and fulfilled through compassionate and direct engagement. This is done in many ways, such as supporting staff with challenges across their projects, their well general being, their professional and personal growth, sharing appreciation, signing birthday cards, celebrating workivesaries and other wins, spontaneous and formal check-ins, etc.

* Offers ideas and helps to implement ways to improve the well being and culture of the company, to continue fostering a conscious and compassionate environment

* Represents the company and our philosophy in larger group settings, such as participating in Fambient hangs/outings, live printing events, and community/volunteer opportunities

* Actively strives to bring a sense of togetherness amongst departments and our staff, whether that be together as a group, or by making an effort to get to know each staff member, individually

* Shares their sympathy when life, family, and personal matters arise, and provides additional support with their work responsibilities as needed

* Provides day-to-day support on the production and webstore floor as needed, in order to stay connected with staff and continually develop a holistic understanding of the company

* Continuously learns and refines conscious leadership skills through podcasts, books, conferences, seminars, and other resources, and shares insights with Managers and Leadership level positions to support collaborative growth

* Understands Ambient Inks on a deep level, including its philosophy, staff/positions, roster, products, services, and provides ideas to continually improve our operations

* Maintains personal accountability, is timely, efficient, organized, precise, proactive, thorough, and collaborative in how they work, and models these attributes to staff

**Operations, Workflow & Systems Improvement**

* Oversees day-to-day operations within Production, Logistics, and Fulfillment, ensuring our clients are satisfied and our products are meeting Ambient Inks’ standards

* Helps to establish benchmarks and goals for the various departments, and supports in the achievement of those goals

* Thinks innovatively on how to improve systems, processes, and policies company-wide in an effort to achieve our goals

* Works with Account Managers to address procedural issues and collaborate to solve problems

* Collaborates with leadership on how to improve efficiencies and create better systems/workflows within their department. Works with leadership to establish goals and holds them accountable for ensuring new systems are implemented and executed, and that goals are being met

* Supports leadership with any major disruptions, errors, or other critical issues. Helps problem solve and works collaboratively on solutions. Brings recurring issues, or those that have large financial impact, to the Managing Director for additional support

* Maintains a consistent pulse on the various departments to ensure they’re functioning well and addresses issues before they become urgent

* Assists Managing Director on building-related needs and interfaces with landlords when necessary

**Management, Leadership Support & Backups**

* Supervises the Production Manager, Fulfillment Manager, and Shipping & Receiving Manager and ensures they have adequate backup when out of office

* Serves as the primary backup to Production Manager, Fulfillment Manager, and Shipping & Receiving Manager

* Serves as a partial backup to the Managing Director

* Contributes in various departments as necessary to provide hands-on support

* Is cross-trained in multiple departments well enough to serve as a backup and/or intermittent support on tasks including but not limited to: Production, Unloading, Catching, Folding, Checking in goods, Podio (project management software), Fulfillment, ShipStation, Batching, Shipping label generation, Shipping & Receiving, Stock-ins/outs, Booking freight, Coordinating international shipping, Palletizing

* Must be able to stand for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours) and consistently lift 25–35lb boxes while supporting certain roles

**Human Resources, Staffing & Policy Development**

* Ensures we have adequate staffing levels in each department. Works closely with leadership and managers to understand and balance workloads across multiple departments. Advocates for hiring when necessary, but also thinks creatively to solve immediate staffing needs

* In tandem with HR Manager and/or Managing Director, facilitates hiring, onboarding, and supporting staff, including addressing workload or performance concerns

* Works with the HR Manager and/or Managing Director to review payroll, as needed, and evaluate staffing levels in each department quarterly. Works with HR Manager & Department Leads to understand revenue vs. staffing need, making hiring recommendations when necessary

* Works in tandem with HR Manager and Managing Director to develop and refine company policies

* Exercises the utmost discretion regarding sensitive or privileged information

* Compassionately and directly facilitates conversations related to challenging topics (performance concerns, interpersonal challenges, conduct issues, etc.)

**Culture, Engagement & Team Well-being**

* Cultivates authenticity and creates an environment where people, both internally and externally, want to work at Ambient Inks

* Spends time connecting with staff, engaging in one-on-one conversations, helping on the floor, celebrating their accomplishments personally and professionally, and gaining insight on how to improve Ambient Inks

* Participates and/or heads the annual Holiday Party Planning Committee

* Ensures break rooms are consistently and adequately stocked with snacks and supplies

**Financials & Strategic Initiatives**

* Has a robust understanding of Ambient Inks’ financials to help with allocating resources, establishing budgets, setting benchmarks, and making financially-based decisions in tandem with Finance Manager, HR Manager, and Managing Director

* Identifies areas of opportunity for us to continually improve our sustainability initiatives and ethos. Continually researches and keeps up to date with sustainability trends, products/brands, and establishes initiatives and methods to support our company in being a leader in this space

* Serves as a Safety Coordinator, and supports fellow safety coordinators and leadership with development of OSHA safety policies. Ensures these are being followed and holds leadership accountable to maintaining these policies and training

**Meetings & Ongoing Collaboration**

* Standing Meetings:, Weekly Monday Morning Meeting, Bi-weekly HR meeting, Monthly financial meetings (as necessary), Quarterly Safety Committee meetings

* Works closely with Production Manager, Fulfillment Manager, and Shipping & Receiving Manager to support capacity planning and system refinement

* Works in tandem with Production Manager/Director to establish the production schedule, and serves as the primary production deadline scheduler

* Works closely with HR Manager to refine systems and develop metrics to track progress

* Connects with staff (on the floor, one-on-one conversations, etc.)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in operations, production, fulfillment, or a similar deadline-driven environment
* 3+ years of experience directly supervising staff, ideally including managers or team leads
* Demonstrated success developing and implementing new systems, workflows, or processes, including measuring results and building staff buy-in
* Experience with scheduling, capacity planning, and balancing workloads across competing deadlines
* Working knowledge of budgets, performance metrics, and how staffing decisions affect the bottom line
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and coaching staff, and addressing performance concerns directly and compassionately
* An emotional intelligence-based leadership style and a genuine commitment to fostering a conscious, compassionate workplace
* Strong organization, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to stay calm and solution-oriented when critical issues arise
* Ability to work regularly from our Eau Claire, WI location, in an open office environment, and provide hands-on support to the departments under their purview. This includes physical requirements like standing for extended periods and lifting up to ~30lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation

Don’t check every box? We’d still love to hear from you! Screen printing experience isn’t required, and we value equivalent experience gained through nontraditional career paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

**Location:**

Please note this is primarily an in-person position. There may be periodic opportunities to work remotely, but for the most part we require this individual work on-site at our facility (2510 Alpine Road, Eau Claire, WI 54703). Reliable transportation is required for this position. We would like this position to be filled by someone living in Eau Claire, WI (or the surrounding area).

**Application Process:**

Please submit your resume, cover letter, and answers to the screening questions

The priority application deadline is **Sunday, November 29th** (however, we will continue to accept applications until the position is filled).

**Thank you!**

We appreciate you taking the time to consider yourself for this position. If you have any questions, please email .

**Intro/Screening Questions**

* What excites you about this position? What draws you to apply?

* What experiences, skills, or attributes do you have that would make you a great fit for this position?

* What is your ideal everyday work environment? This could be anything from the music played, the amount of team member interaction, the general vibe, or simply the physical space you’re in. Anything goes here.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* What excites you about this position? What draws you to apply?
* What experiences, skills, or attributes do you have that would make you a great fit for this position?
* What is your ideal everyday work environment? This could be anything from the music played, the amount of team member interaction, the general vibe, or simply the physical space you’re in. Anything goes here.

Work Location: In person
